openPositions.title: Sales Executive
jobDescriptions: Acknowledging the New customers / fielding customer queries / using this to create interest in the Sales.
Routing the customer order flow & closing sales of accounts received by account payable transactions.
Taking care of accounting tasks written & assisting in VAT reconciliations.
Coordinating with internal group departments for Material Delivery / Material enquiry / Material Availability & coordinating the same to the customers.
Meeting customer/order relevant meetings, provides quotation to customers/reviews new policy.
Ensuring the product knowledge to all our products / New entries.

openPositions.title: Design Consultant - Architectural Hardware
openPositions.qualification: B.Arch / Interior Design / Diploma in Architecture
jobDescriptions: Assisting architects and interior designers in hardware specifications for prestige projects.
Providing customized hardware solutions for residential, hospitality, and commercial spaces.
Conducting technical presentations and walkthroughs at TAITON Experience Centers.
Coordinating with project managers and site consultants for seamless installation.
requiredSkills: Strong understanding of architectural blueprints and fittings.
Proficiency in CAD and architectural drafting tools.
Excellent consultative communication and client relationship skills.

openPositions.title: Quality & Operations Coordinator
openPositions.qualification: Any Graduate / Diploma in Logistics / Supply Chain
jobDescriptions: Inspecting incoming inventory and ensuring zero-defect standards for dispatched architectural hardware.
Coordinating with regional distribution hubs across India for rapid dispatch within 24-48 hours.
Managing stock replenishment and warehouse logistics software tracking.
requiredSkills: Attention to detail and quality control processes.
Experience with ERP and inventory management tools.

openPositions.title: Regional Key Account Manager
openPositions.qualification: MBA / Any Graduate with 3+ years experience in building materials
jobDescriptions: Developing long-term relationships with tier-1 builders, contractors, and corporate clients.
Managing regional dealer network performance and expanding distribution footprint.
Achieving quarterly revenue targets and securing high-value project tenders.
requiredSkills: High negotiation capability and account management experience.
Deep familiarity with architectural hardware distribution.
Proven track record of B2B sales success.

openPositions.title: Technical Hardware Specialist (Digital Locks & Automation)
openPositions.qualification: Diploma / Degree in Electronics / Mechanical Engineering
jobDescriptions: Providing on-site and remote technical support for automatic doors and smart digital locks.
Training dealer technician teams on installation, programming, and maintenance.
Troubleshooting complex electronic access and glass sliding mechanisms.
requiredSkills: Hands-on technical knowledge of digital access control systems.
Problem diagnosis and electro-mechanical repair proficiency.
Customer-centric attitude and clear technical instruction skills.
